name: 21005-prefill-125m-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node (--gres=gpu:1).
load_profile: constant (OPEN loop), rate=200 req/s, bounded at 2000 requests with a 900 s safety cap, first 20% by completion discarded as warmup.
workload: GuideLLM `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix buckets, prompt exactly 700 tokens and output exactly 1 with ignore_eos; request_format `plain`, because this checkpoint's tokenizer has no chat template. The OPT tokenizer prepends a BOS, so the engine sees ~701 tokens.
purpose: A compact text classifier scoring 700-token documents into one-token verdicts at 200 requests per second on a single GPU.
launch:
# vLLM at commit b2eb2b5ad7090ad3b3e002b200104a82eeb2fa7f (v0.9.2rc1-339-gb2eb2b5ad709).
model: facebook/opt-125m
dtype: float16
enable-prefix-caching: false
swap-space: 16
disable-log-requests: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Pinned on purpose, not defaults: built in-process through AsyncLLMEngine these fall through to
# 128 / 2048 instead of the 1024 / 8192 an OpenAI-API-server launch resolves to on this card.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
